objective: Finalize one robust, economically distinct exit state machine for BULL, RANGE, and BEAR without using the untouched 2020 holdout for selection.

evidence_before_lock.BULL: A 25% partial at +24% ROE with a +3% residual floor and 6% ROE prior-peak giveback slightly dominated the full-position trail center while preserving six positive calendar periods.
evidence_before_lock.RANGE: A full-position trail armed at +18% ROE with 1.5% ROE giveback preserved 91.7% of fixed-horizon expectancy and improved drawdown 4.6%. R7 tests an earlier BB-resolution exit while retaining the same 6h risk ceiling.
evidence_before_lock.BEAR: A fixed completed-4h recovery-failure checkpoint plus BB-recovery target around 1.75 and a high-profit trail produced six positive periods, 80%+ expectancy retention, 30% drawdown improvement, and 70%+ strategic exits, but the coarse target grid did not establish a plateau.

immutable_common.same_bar_order: previous-bar protection first; current high cannot tighten a stop against current low

BULL_PARTIAL_LOCAL.economic_role: Take a small first profit in a structural bull market, then retain most exposure with an earned residual floor and prior-peak protection.

RANGE_RESOLUTION_LOCAL.economic_role: Exit the full position when the range displacement has substantially mean-reverted, or protect an earned profit; 6h remains only the unresolved-range ceiling.

RANGE_TRAIL_LOCAL_CONTROL.economic_role: Local control surface around the validated R4 profit-protection center.

BEAR_RECOVERY_LOCAL.economic_role: Countertrend rebound: abandon a failed completed-4h recovery, realize a large BB reconvergence, or protect an unusually large profit; 24h is the final countertrend ceiling.

neighborhood.BULL: Chebyshev distance <= 1 across T1 ROE, partial fraction, residual floor, and trail giveback ordinal axes.
neighborhood.RANGE: Chebyshev distance <= 1 across target BB improvement, trail arm, and trail giveback ordinal axes; controls without a state target are evaluated as a separate surface.
neighborhood.BEAR: Chebyshev distance <= 1 across BB recovery target, trail arm, and trail giveback ordinal axes. The completed 4h failure checkpoint is fixed as a market-structure mechanism.

selection_rule: Select only from a connected local plateau passing every lane gate. Prefer the simplest lane-specific state machine, then highest worst-calendar mean, then expectancy retention, then drawdown improvement, then lower time-backstop rate, then candidate key.
